Reference

Command reference

Every command, at a glance. All commands start with ghostty-wall.

The complete command set#

CommandWhat it does
ghostty-wall initInitialize the managed directory and add the Ghostty integration hook.
ghostty-wall init --dry-runPreview initialization without writing files.
ghostty-wall init --repairConservatively repair the managed layout and integration hook.
ghostty-wall init --welcomeAdd the bundled welcome profile to an eligible empty installation.
ghostty-wall init --migrate-legacyImport recognized wallpaper sources and integration from Bash v0.
ghostty-wall plan PROFILEResolve a profile and inspect its environment without changing files.
ghostty-wall apply PROFILEApply a profile and record an activation in local history.
ghostty-wall previousReplay the preceding environment from local history.
ghostty-wall tuiBrowse profiles, preview them, and apply them interactively.
ghostty-wall doctorRun read-only checks of installation, integration, and durable state.
ghostty-wall uninstallRemove integration and generated files, preserving profiles and history.
ghostty-wall --helpShow CLI usage.
ghostty-wall --versionShow the installed version.

Useful flags#

FlagUse
--seed HEXUse with plan, apply, and tui for random-selection profiles.
plan PROFILE --jsonCompact machine-readable JSON. Errors also use structured JSON and a nonzero exit code.
init --migrate-legacy --dry-runInspect a legacy migration before making changes.

An everyday workflow#

Terminal
ghostty-wall plan night
ghostty-wall apply night
ghostty-wall previous
ghostty-wall doctor
Version 1 scope

There are no next, history, direct random/set, or automatic cleanup commands in v1.
